hooks.command: node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>s+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{var j=JSON.parse(s);var bs=String.fromCharCode(92);var p=((j.tool_input||{}).file_path||'').split(bs).join('/').toLowerCase();var g=p.endsWith('/docs/glossary.md')||p.startsWith('docs/glossary.md');var scope=p.startsWith('docs/')||p.includes('/docs/')||p.startsWith('src/')||p.includes('/src/')||p.startsWith('specs/')||p.includes('/specs/');if(scope&&!g){process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'PostToolUse',additionalContext:'Glossary reminder: if this change introduces or renames a domain term, add or update its docs/GLOSSARY.md row.'}}));}}catch(e){}process.exit(0);});"
